name: Fider
description: Fider is an open platform to collect and prioritize customer feedback. Users post ideas, vote and comment on them, while the team responds, sets each idea's status and shares a roadmap, so the most requested features rise to the top.

notes.text: Fider signs users in with emailed links: fill in the SMTP fields when creating the container, or set EMAIL_SMTP_* in /opt/fider_data/.env and run systemctl restart fider.
Without SMTP, submit the setup form, then run su postgres -c "psql fider -tAc 'select key from email_verifications order by id desc limit 1'" and open http://<IP>:3000/signup/verify?k=<key>.

app_vars.name: var_smtp_port
app_vars.label: SMTP Port
app_vars.help: 465 uses implicit TLS, other ports STARTTLS
